name: tier-router
description: Routes each subagent task to Haiku, Sonnet or Opus by difficulty, sets and adjusts its effort, learns from results, and reports what ran and what it cost.

profile.title: Routing profile
profile.description: How difficulty maps to model and effort. frugal leans cheaper, quality leans stronger.

maxModel.title: Strongest model allowed
maxModel.description: Cap on the model any subagent gets. Tasks above the cap run on it at one effort level higher.

hardestModel.title: Model for the very hardest tasks
hardestModel.description: Choose fable only if your plan includes Claude Fable.

classifier.title: Ask Haiku to rate unclear tasks
classifier.description: When keyword rules are unsure, one small Haiku request rates the task's difficulty. Off: rules only, no extra requests.

adaptiveEffort.title: Raise effort when a subagent struggles
adaptiveEffort.description: Raises a running subagent's effort after repeated tool errors or a long run, up to two levels.

learn.title: Learn from results
learn.description: Adjusts future routing per kind of task when subagents report being stuck, or when work was easy for a strong model.

nudge.title: Encourage Claude to delegate
nudge.description: Tells Claude that delegating self-contained work is cheap while routing is on.

respectExplicit.title: Keep a model or effort Claude was asked to use
respectExplicit.description: When an Agent call already names a model or effort, keep it instead of routing that part.

extraAgents.title: Extra agent types to route
extraAgents.description: Comma-separated names of your own subagent types to route too. Built-in general-purpose, claude, Explore and Plan are always routed.
